answer: Bind each earning identity to a deduplicated postal address: the operator gets a paper postcard with a one-time code and must enter it within 14 days. Addresses are normalized (unit, ZIP+4), so a farm in one warehouse at the canyon mouth earns one seat, not fifty. Each extra alias needs its own mailable address, about $10/month for a virtual box, so N aliases cost N leases and N cards. Check: a fresh code is re-mailed every 90 days, and boxes that bounce or forward to one summit hub are collapsed; a comet-like burst of new boxes in one ZIP triggers review.
